# cato_webhooks (Data Source)

The `cato_webhooks` data source fetches information about account webhook integrations with optional filters. Returns a list of webhooks matching the filter criteria. Never exposes `auth` or `body`: the underlying list query never selects webhook secrets.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id_filter` (List of String) List of webhook IDs to filter by
- `name_filter` (List of String) List of webhook names to filter by

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of webhooks matching the filter criteria (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is enabled
- `header` (Attributes List) Additional HTTP headers sent with the request (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--header))
- `id` (String) Webhook ID
- `name` (String) Webhook name
- `related_webhook_id` (String) Related webhook ID, if any
- `request_method` (String) HTTP request method
- `response_mapping` (Attributes List) Key/value pairs mapped out of the webhook response (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--response_mapping))
- `url` (String) Destination URL

<a id="nestedatt--items--header"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.header`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `value` (String, Sensitive)


<a id="nestedatt--items--response_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.response_mapping`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)
